propositions: Five dependency packages must be updated: botocore, genai-prices, json-repair, mypy, and ruff; the resolved versions are 1.43.75, 0.1.4, 0.63.3, 2.3.1, and 0.16.3 respectively, exceeding the original PR's proposed pins.
A Gerrit change must be created and landed on main since GitHub is read-only; the mirror will then auto-close PR #131 when it syncs the merged commit.
make lint and make typecheck must pass under the new ruff 0.16.3 and mypy 2.3.1 with zero source code changes required; no new findings were surfaced that needed fixing.
The complexity baseline ratchet must remain unmodified with zero new violations and zero increased violations under the new ruff version.
After Gerrit merge and mirror sync, PR #131 must be verified as auto-closed by dependabot with a cross-reference to the landed change.
